items.title: 67255_Helen Humes oral history interview
items.q: all I know is that whenever we meet we say, hello, and we may have a drink together, something like that.

ctx.x: Yeah. And she was full of heart.

Yeah. You know, people would come in and ask me, you know she did this and she did that. I said, I don't know nothing. I didn't visit nobody. And I said, all I know is that whenever we meet we say, hello, and we may have a drink together, something like that. And I do know that when she was very, very bad off and they would have her locked in her dressing room and they wouldn't let nobody see her.
